column1: # Sheriff / primary law-enforcement agency per county. SHIPS EMPTY ON PURPOSE.
# There is no clean national machine-readable source for sheriff office names
# and non-emergency numbers. The FBI UCR agency tables cover agency names but
# not phone numbers; state POST/LE directories vary in format and licence.
# Rather than publish a number that might be wrong
# any county not listed renders as "not in dataset".
# A wrong non-emergency number is worse than a missing one: it fails at the
# moment someone actually dials it. Only add rows you have verified
# the year you verified them in the vintage column so the next person can see
# source = where you got it (agency website
# vintage= the year you verified it
